title: Internal: handling procedure for activating a purchased Personal Training Packages package
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a member's payment for a previously applied-for package is captured, the agent activates the package, crediting it with its computed session count and setting its expiration date.

## Prerequisite
This document states as a general clause that activating the package must not leave the member holding more than the per-member limit on concurrently open packages (any status other than closed) on this category, counting the package being activated itself. Where an already-open package on this category has gone stale and been administratively archived first, it no longer counts toward that total. Where activating the package would still leave the member over that limit, the package is not activated.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): activate_pt_package_46fb321d.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the applied-for package being activated, reachable from the confirmation returned when the package was applied for.
- sessions_granted: the whole number of sessions to credit to the package at activation, a non-negative whole number of sessions, or -1 to denote unlimited use, passed as the full computed number of sessions owed.
- expiration_date: the date unused sessions in this package will expire, in YYYY-MM-DD format, passed as the correct computed expiration date for this package.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the package's reference number, its new status, its session balance, and its expiration date; the status reading active indicates the activation was recorded successfully. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no change is recorded.
